paragraphs.en: Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
paragraphs.cn: 金黄的树林里分出两条路，

paragraphs.en: And sorry I could not travel both
paragraphs.cn: 可惜我不能同时去涉足

paragraphs.en: And be one traveler, long I stood
paragraphs.cn: 作为一个旅人，我久久伫立

paragraphs.en: And looked down one as far as I could
To where it bent in the undergrowth.
paragraphs.cn: 直到它消失在丛林深处。

paragraphs.en: I took the one less traveled by,
paragraphs.cn: 我选择了人迹更少的那条路，

paragraphs.en: And that has made all the difference.
paragraphs.cn: 而这使得一切变得不同。
